1Look at the fridge. Complete with a, an, some or any.

aansomeany
  1. 1

    There is milk in the jug above the fruit.

  2. 2

    There are apples beside the two oranges.

  3. 3

    There is cucumber in the bottom compartment.

  4. 4

    There aren’t bananas on the fruit shelf.

  5. 5

    There is bowl of yoghurt beside the cheese.

  6. 6

    There are carrots next to the egg tray.

  7. 7

    There isn’t orange juice in the door shelves.

  8. 8

    There is head of lettuce beside the cucumber.

  9. 9

    There is cheese on the white plate.

  10. 10

    There aren’t tomatoes anywhere in the fridge.

  11. 11

    There is egg tray below the fruit shelf.

  12. 12

    There are oranges beside the apples.

  13. 13

    There isn’t meat on the shelves.

  14. 14

    There is plate under the block of cheese.

  15. 15

    There are eggs in the clear tray.

2Choose the correct option. Use the quantity clues in each sentence.

  1. 1

    Only two eggs are left, so we have eggs for breakfast.

  2. 2

    There is milk left; it is enough for one small cup.

  3. 3

    The kitchen has twenty bags of flour, so there is flour.

  4. 4

    We bought only three carrots, so we have carrots for the soup.

  5. 5

    The bowl contains just one spoonful of yoghurt, so there is yoghurt.

  6. 6

    There are thirty apples in the box, so we have apples.

  7. 7

    Only two biscuits remain on the plate, so there are biscuits.

  8. 8

    The jar is almost empty, but there is honey at the bottom.

  9. 9

    We have ten litres of water for the trip, so there is water.

  10. 10

    There are only three mushrooms left, so we can add mushrooms.

  11. 11

    Just a teaspoon of oil remains, so there is oil in the bottle.

  12. 12

    The shop delivered fifty eggs today, so the chef has eggs.

  13. 13

    Only two oranges are in the bag, so there are oranges.

  14. 14

    There is only a small piece of butter, so we have butter.

  15. 15

    The pantry contains fifteen packets of pasta, so we have pasta.

3Complete the sentences. Choose the correct expression from the options in brackets.

  1. 1

    We haven’t got flour, so please buy a packet before you come home.

  2. 2

    There is onion on the board; chop it before heating the pan.

  3. 3

    I have fresh vegetables for tonight’s soup, and I want to wash them now.

  4. 4

    Only a small amount remains, so add milk to make the sauce thinner.

  5. 5

    There are only three guests, so prepare sandwiches for them.

  6. 6

    We need egg to brush over the pastry before baking it.

  7. 7

    There isn’t cheese left, so we cannot make cheese sandwiches.

  8. 8

    The chef bought forty tomatoes because she needs tomatoes for the festival.

  9. 9

    Would you like soup before the main course?

  10. 10

    Could I have glass of water with my lunch, please?

  11. 11

    Do we have mushrooms to add to the sauce?

  12. 12

    Only two pieces remain, but we can still share chocolate after dinner.

  13. 13

    There are oranges in the basket, and we can use them for juice.

  14. 14

    We need apple to finish the fruit salad for our guest.

  15. 15

    There are only two cloves left, so we have cloves of garlic for the dip.
